service.description:
ISO/DIS 24882 Tappa 4: for a ThreatScenario GraphVertex, sums its 5 analyst-assigned Likelihood sub-scores (CyberElapsedTimeParam/ CyberSpecialistExpertiseParam/CyberKnowledgeOfSoIParam/ CyberWindowOfOpportunityParam/CyberEquipmentParam - Table 5), bands the sum into a Likelihood Rating per Table 10, takes the maximum Overall Impact across every DamageScenario this threat REALIZES_DAMAGE_SCENARIO (Table 1-4), and looks up the Risk Rating per Table 11 - all three tables verified verbatim against the real loaded ISO-DIS-24882 norm text (see design-session/SESSION.md). Writes the three computed values back onto the ThreatScenario vertex as Parameters.
This is a MmtCodeDefinedFunction MathModel (MM_THREAT_SCENARIO_RISK, see CyberMachineGraphMetadataSeedData.xml), following the same math-model-run-tracking pattern as check#ProductCategoryCompliance/check#DeviceGroupContinuityImpact.
